Agent Name: Geospatial_Expert  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Geospatial_Expert incorrectly concluded that the Nominatim geocoding service could resolve all karting track and paintball place addresses after the initial failure with the `geopy` library and an invalid Google Maps API key. While the Nominatim service successfully geocoded the karting track addresses (excluding the one outside Cologne), the conversation ended prematurely without validating the geocoded data or proceeding to calculate walking distances and filtering based on the 10-minute constraint. This failure to complete the outlined plan led to an incomplete solution to the problem.
